evaluation._comment: LSTM-only benchmark: 1 encoding × 1 repeat. ~32 train + 8 val samples. 3 epochs. NO SNN to isolate LSTM performance.

_comment: LSTM throughput benchmark (.wiki/Guides/LSTM-Performance.md). model.time_steps governs the BASELINES too, not only the SNN arm: run_baseline feeds the LSTM a time-major (T*B, F) tensor, so the sequence length is T*window/lstm_frame_size. Declared explicitly at 16 to match the production profiles -- inheriting the struct default would silently change what this benchmark measures. Migrated to LOSO 2026-09-23: the legacy pooled/shuffled split (cv_fold unset) was removed -- it let the same speaker/recording land in both train and validation, the leakage defect a reviewer flagged as strong-reject on submission 71. Its recorded wall time predates this migration and a prior 16x-shorter-unroll change -- treat the numbers in LSTM-Performance.md as stale until re-measured.
